stem: Several plants show similar yellowing, but only in one irrigation zone. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Diagnose a named deficiency from leaf color alone
Map the pattern and compare root-zone pH/EC, irrigation delivery, roots, environment and consistent tissue samples before selecting a correction
rationale: Visual symptoms can have multiple causes and do not always align simply with tissue concentration. Spatial root-zone and irrigation evidence can distinguish competing hypotheses.
